# Josephine Barry

[Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood)

## Overview

- **Age:** presumed seventy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Titles:** Miss (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P25](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0025)</sub>
- **Family:** [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Josephine Barry is an older woman with a thin, prim, and rigid bearing and a wrinkled cheek. She wears gold-rimmed glasses, through which her sharp black eyes often snap or twinkle.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P77](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0077), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P17](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031)_

## Personality

Miss Barry is a critical and rather selfish old lady who historically cared little for anyone besides herself. Despite these traits, she can be a most hospitable host who treats her guests royally.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P26](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0026), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008)_

## History

Josephine Barry, an aunt who lived in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), was infuriated when [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) unexpectedly leaped onto her while she was sleeping in the spare-room bed at Diana's house. However, after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) went to her directly to offer an honest apology and defend [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), Miss Barry was won over, forgave [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and chose to extend her stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). She later hosted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) at her mansion for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition) and frequently received visits from [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) while the girl attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). Miss Barry also attended the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) commencement when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) won the Avery scholarship.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P9](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. ## Quotes

> "I dare say your claim to sympathy is just as strong as mine. It all depends on the way we look at it. Sit down here and tell me about yourself."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P88](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0088)

> "Remember, you Anne-girl, when you come to town you’re to visit me and I’ll put you in my very sparest spare-room bed to sleep."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P96](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0096)

> "Oh, I must, hey? I rather think Diana did her share of the jumping at least. Such carryings on in a respectable house!"
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P82](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0082)

> "Mercy, child, how you have grown! You’re taller than I am, I declare. And you’re ever so much better-looking than you used to be, too. But I dare say you know that without being told."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P18](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0018)

> "She amuses me, and at my time of life an amusing person is a rarity."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P92](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0092)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--josephine-barry.md)

Josephine Barry's relationship with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) began on a contentious note after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) mistakenly leaped on her while she was sleeping in Diana's spare-room bed. However, after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) personally apologized and gave an honest confession, Miss Barry took a liking to her, forgave [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and chose to remain in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Over time, Miss Barry welcomed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to her mansion for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition) and eventually expressed deep pride in Anne's achievements at Commencement.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P9](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. ### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--josephine-barry.md)

[Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) is Josephine Barry's niece. Miss Barry hosts [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at her mansion for trips into town and includes her in family events, such as inviting her cousins and taking the girls to the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition).
